template_metadata.description: Template for mapping functions to services/systems - bridges functional architecture (WHAT functions) to service architecture (WHICH service implements WHICH function)
template_metadata.usage: Copy this template to specs/functional/functional_allocation_matrix.json and populate with function-to-service mappings
template_metadata.purpose: Enable traceability from functional requirements through functions to service implementations

allocation_summary.functions_unallocated: {Number of functions not yet allocated - gaps}

allocated_functions.allocation_reason: {Why this function belongs to this service - cohesion, bounded context, etc.}
function_dependencies: {List of other function IDs this function depends on}
cross_service_dependencies: {List of services this function needs to call}

services.cohesion_score: {0.0-1.0: How related are the allocated functions? 1.0 = perfect cohesion}
services.coupling_score: {0.0-1.0: How many cross-service dependencies? 0.0 = no coupling (ideal), 1.0 = high coupling}
services.bounded_context: {Domain or business capability this service represents}

services.service_description: Handles user authentication, session management, and access control

allocated_functions.allocation_reason: Entry point for authentication flow - naturally part of auth service
Core authentication logic - high cohesion with auth service
Session management is part of authentication bounded context

unallocated_functions.reason_unallocated: {Why this function hasn't been allocated - gap, deferred decision, etc.}
unallocated_functions.proposed_service: {Suggested service for this function, or 'NEW SERVICE' if none fit}
unallocated_functions.allocation_blocker: {What's preventing allocation - missing service, unclear bounded context, etc.}

allocation_quality_metrics.average_cohesion_score: {0.0-1.0: Average cohesion across all services - higher is better}
allocation_quality_metrics.average_coupling_score: {0.0-1.0: Average coupling across all services - lower is better}

services_requiring_refactoring.recommendation: {Suggested refactoring - split service, move functions, etc.}

allocation_validation.service_coverage: {Percentage of services with at least one allocated function}
validation_issues: {List any validation issues - unallocated functions, orphaned services, circular dependencies}

allocation_principles: High cohesion: Group functions that work together (same bounded context, same data model)
Low coupling: Minimize cross-service function calls (reduce inter-service dependencies)
Domain-driven design: Follow bounded contexts from domain model
Single responsibility: Each service should have one clear purpose
Function dependencies: Keep dependent functions in same service when possible
llm_agent_guidance.allocation_process: 1) Read functional architecture and identify function groups by domain, 2) Create service candidates for each domain group, 3) Allocate functions to services, 4) Calculate cohesion/coupling scores, 5) Refactor if scores are poor (cohesion < 0.7 or coupling > 0.3), 6) Validate 100% coverage
llm_agent_guidance.when_to_create_new_service: Create new service when: (1) Functions don't fit existing services, (2) New bounded context identified, (3) Grouping would violate single responsibility principle

bottom_up_vs_top_down.top_down: Create new services based on functional grouping - greenfield allocation
bottom_up_vs_top_down.bottom_up: Map functions to existing components from component_inventory.json - constraint-based allocation. Functions that don't fit existing components are marked as gaps requiring new components.
